methods.name: dispose
methods.javadoc_description: Clears internal caches and mappings to free memory.

methods.name: fromCollection

params.name: trees
params.description: - the collection of trees

methods.javadoc_description: Creates a TreeStatistics instance from a group of Trees and a specific metric for convenient retrieval of histograms

methods.name: getAllMetrics
methods.javadoc_description: Gets the list of supported metrics.

methods.name: getAnnotatedLength

params.name: level
params.description: - the ontological depth of the compartments to be considered

overloads.return_description: the map containing the brain compartments as keys, and cable lengths as values.

methods.javadoc_description: Retrieves the amount of cable length present on each brain compartment innervated by the analyzed neuron.

methods.name: getAnnotatedLengthsByHemisphere

params.name: level
params.description: - the ontological depth of the compartments to be considered

overloads.return_description: the map containing the brain compartments as keys, and cable lengths per hemisphere as values.

methods.javadoc_description: Retrieves the amount of cable length present on each brain compartment innervated by the analyzed neuron in the two brain hemispheres. Lengths are absolute and not normalized to the cells' cable length.

methods.name: getAnnotations

params.name: depth
params.description: - the max. ontological depth of the compartments to be retrieved

methods.javadoc_description: Retrieves the brain compartments (neuropil labels) associated with the Tree being measured innervated by the analyzed neuron.

methods.name: getAvgBranchLength

throws.IllegalArgumentException: - if tree contains multiple roots or loops

methods.javadoc_description: Gets average length for all the branches of the analyzed tree.

methods.name: getAvgContraction

throws.IllegalArgumentException: - if tree contains multiple roots or loops

methods.javadoc_description: Gets average `contraction` for all the branches of the analyzed tree.

methods.name: getAvgFractalDimension

throws.IllegalArgumentException: - if the tree contains multiple roots or loops

methods.javadoc_description: Gets the average fractal dimension of the analyzed tree. Note that branches with less than 5 points are ignored during the computation.

methods.name: getAvgFragmentation

overloads.return_description: the average no. of branch nodes (average branch fragmentation)

throws.IllegalArgumentException: - if tree contains multiple roots or loops

methods.javadoc_description: Gets the average no. of nodes (fragmentation) for all the branches of the analyzed tree.

methods.name: getAvgPartitionAsymmetry

throws.IllegalArgumentException: - if the tree contains multiple roots or loops

methods.javadoc_description: Gets the average partition asymmetry of the analyzed tree. Note that branch points with more than 2 children are ignored during the computation.

methods.name: getAvgRemoteBifAngle

throws.IllegalArgumentException: - if the tree contains multiple roots or loops

methods.javadoc_description: Gets the average remote bifurcation angle of the analyzed tree. Note that branch points with more than 2 children are ignored during the computation.

methods.name: getBranchPoints

params.name: annot
params.description: - the BrainAnnotation to be queried.

overloads.return_description: the branch points positions, or an empty set if no branch points were retrieved

methods.javadoc_description: Gets the position of all the branch points in the analyzed tree associated with the specified annotation.

methods.name: getBranches

overloads.return_description: the list of branches as Path objects.

throws.IllegalArgumentException: - if tree contains multiple roots or loops

methods.javadoc_description: Gets all the branches in the analyzed tree. A branch is defined as the Path composed of all the nodes between two branching points or between one branching point and a termination point.

methods.name: getCableLength

params.name: compartment
params.description: - the query compartment (null not allowed)

methods.javadoc_description: Gets the cable length associated with the specified compartment (neuropil label).

methods.name: getCableLengthNorm

params.name: compartment
params.description: - the query compartment (null not allowed)

overloads.return_description: the filtered cable length normalized to total cable length

methods.javadoc_description: Gets the cable length associated with the specified compartment (neuropil label) as a ratio of total length.

methods.javadoc_description: Convenience method to obtain a single-value metric from `ConvexHullAnalyzer`

methods.javadoc_description: Returns the depth of the `BoundingBox` box of the tree being measured

methods.javadoc_description: Assembles a Flow plot (aka Sankey diagram) for the specified feature.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.javadoc_description: Returns the height of the `BoundingBox` box of the tree being measured

methods.name: getHighestPathOrder

overloads.return_description: the highest Path order, or -1 if Paths in the Tree have no defined order

methods.javadoc_description: Gets the highest `path order` of the analyzed tree

methods.name: getInnerLength

overloads.return_description: the length sum of all inner branches

methods.javadoc_description: Gets the cable length of inner branches

params.name: metric
params.description: - the single-value metric to be computed (case-insensitive). While it is expected to be an element of getAllMetrics(), unless isExactMetricMatch() is set,

overloads.return_description: the computed value (average if metric is associated with multiple values)

methods.javadoc_description: Computes the specified metric.

methods.name: getMetrics

overloads.return_description: the list of commonly used metrics.

methods.javadoc_description: Gets the list of most commonly used metrics.

params.name: annot

methods.javadoc_description: Gets the number of branch points in the analyzed tree associated with the specified annotation.

methods.name: getNNodes
methods.javadoc_description: Gets the number of nodes in the analyzed tree.

methods.name: getNPaths
methods.javadoc_description: Gets the no. of parsed paths.

params.name: annot
params.description: - the BrainAnnotation to be queried.

methods.javadoc_description: Gets the number of end points in the analyzed tree associated with the specified annotation.

methods.name: getNTipsNorm

params.name: annot
params.description: - the BrainAnnotation to be queried.

methods.javadoc_description: Gets the percentage of end points in the analyzed tree associated with the specified annotation

methods.name: getNoSpinesOrVaricosities
methods.javadoc_description: Gets the number of spines/varicosities that have been (manually) assigned to tree being analyzed.

methods.name: getParsedTree

overloads.return_description: the set of paths currently being considered for analysis.

methods.javadoc_description: Returns the set of parsed Paths.

methods.name: getPartitionAsymmetry

methods.name: getPolarHistogram

params.name: metric

throws.UnknownMetricException: - if the metric is not recognized

methods.javadoc_description: Assembles a polar histogram for the specified metric (assumed to be an angular measurements (e.g., branch angles, path orientations).

methods.name: getPrimaryBranches

overloads.return_description: the primary branches. Note that these branches (Path segments) will not carry any connectivity information.

methods.javadoc_description: Retrieves the primary branches of the analyzed Tree. Primary branches (or root-associated) have origin in the Tree's root, extending to the closest branch/end-point. Note that a primary branch can also be terminal.

methods.name: getPrimaryLength

overloads.return_description: the length sum of all primary branches

methods.javadoc_description: Gets the cable length of primary branches.

methods.name: getPrimaryPaths
methods.javadoc_description: Retrieves all the Paths in the analyzed Tree tagged as primary.

methods.name: getRemoteBifAngles

overloads.return_description: the list of remote bifurcation angles

throws.IllegalArgumentException: - if the tree contains multiple roots or loops

methods.javadoc_description: Gets the angle between each bifurcation point and its children in the simplified graph, which comprise either branch points or terminal nodes. Note that branch points with more than 2 children are ignored.

params.name: metric

methods.javadoc_description: Convenience method to obtain a single-value metric from `RootAngleAnalyzer`.

overloads.return_description: the ShollAnalyzer instance associated with this TreeStatistics instance

methods.name: getSummaryStats

params.name: metric
params.description: - the measurement (N_NODES, NODE_RADIUS, etc.)

methods.javadoc_description: Computes the `SummaryStatistics` for the specified measurement.

methods.name: getTable
methods.javadoc_description: Gets the table currently being used by this TreeStatistics instance

methods.name: getTerminalBranches

overloads.return_description: the terminal branches. Note that as per `Path.getSection(int, int)`, these branches will not carry any connectivity information.

methods.javadoc_description: Retrieves the terminal branches of the analyzed Tree. A terminal branch corresponds to the section of a terminal Path between its last branch-point and its terminal point (tip). A terminal branch can also be primary.

methods.name: getTerminalLength

overloads.return_description: the length sum of all terminal branches

methods.javadoc_description: Gets the cable length of terminal branches

methods.name: getTips

params.name: annot
params.description: - the minimum distance from root (inclusive, in the same units as tree coordinates)

overloads.return_description: the set of terminal points within the specified distance range from root, or an empty set if no tips are found within the range or if the tree has no root

methods.javadoc_description: Gets the position of all tips in the analyzed tree that are within the specified distance range from the root. This method is useful for analyzing tree morphology within specific distance bands from the soma.

methods.name: getUnit

params.name: metric
params.description: - the metric to be queried (case-insensitive)

overloads.return_description: physical unit, or an empty string if the metric is dimensionless

methods.javadoc_description: Returns the physical unit associated with the specified metric. This is the single source of truth for metric units: histograms, tables and color legends all rely on it.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.javadoc_description: Returns the width of the `BoundingBox` box of the tree being measured

methods.name: isExactMetricMatch

overloads.return_description: true if only exact (case and punctuation insensitive) matching is active, false if loose phrases such as "# bps" are also matched

methods.javadoc_description: Checks if 'fuzzy matching' of metrics is disabled for this instance.

methods.name: isValid

overloads.return_description: true, if Tree is valid, false otherwise

methods.javadoc_description: Checks whether this tree is topologically valid, i.e., contains only one root and no loops.

methods.name: measure

params.name: metrics
params.description: - the row header label

methods.javadoc_description: Measures this Tree, outputting the result to the measurements table. If a Context has been specified, the table is updated. Otherwise, table contents are printed to Console.

methods.name: resetRestrictions
methods.javadoc_description: Removes any filtering restrictions that may have been set. Once called, subsequent analysis will use all paths initially parsed by the constructor. Does nothing if no paths are currently being excluded from the analysis.

methods.name: restrictToSWCType

params.name: types
params.description: - the allowed SWC flags (e.g., Path.SWC_AXON, etc.)

methods.javadoc_description: Restricts analysis to Paths sharing the specified SWC flag(s).

methods.name: run
methods.javadoc_description: Generates detailed summaries in which measurements are grouped by SWC-type flags

methods.name: setExactMetricMatch

params.name: exactMetricMatch
params.description: - if true, loose phrases are not matched and an UnknownMetricException is thrown instead

methods.javadoc_description: Sets whether loose phrases (e.g., "# bps" or "n junctions") should be matched to the closest supported metric when retrieving metrics. By default, they are. Names that differ from a supported metric only in case, spacing or punctuation are always matched.

methods.name: setTable

params.name: table
params.description: - the table to be used by this TreeStatistics instance

methods.javadoc_description: Sets the table for this TreeStatistics instance.

methods.name: summarize

params.name: groupByType
params.description: - the String to be used as label for the summary

methods.javadoc_description: Outputs a summary of the current analysis to the measurements table.

methods.name: updateAndDisplayTable
methods.javadoc_description: Updates and displays the measurements table. If `Context` has not been set (running headless!?), table is printed to Console.

javadoc_description: Computes summary and descriptive statistics from properties of Paths and Nodes in a `Tree`, including convenience methods to plot distributions of such data. For analysis of groups of Trees have a look at `MultiTreeStatistics` and `GroupedTreeStatistics`.
